t: The Barbary States - The Final Yarrs

q.x: The REvil crowd has managed to get to the point where the rather large US anti-terrorism community is focused on them. That usually doesn't end well. [1] [link]

desc:
Today we start to look at the last half-century of the history of the Barbary States and how they eventually became the architects of their own demise.
